META MAKER SPACE 는
META DATA - 데이터를 위한 데이터,
META LEARNING - 학습을 위한 학습,
META ANALYSIS - 분석을 위한 분석 처럼
MAKER SPACE 를 위한 MAKER SPACE 라는 뜻입니다.
​경북 거점 전문랩으로서
경북과 전국의 메이커스페이스, 메이커,  제조중소기업을 지원합니다.
Main: 환영
2022년 4월 1일 POSTECH META MAKERSPACE 가 중소벤처기업부 선정 경북거점 전문랩으로 선정되었습니다.
​
CHANGeUP GROUND 3층과 C5 지하 1층, 기기가공실 총 3개의 건물에 Maker Space 를 준비하여 다양한 기기들과 재료를 안전하게 다루기 위한 Workshop 및 수업을 제공하게 되었습니다. 메이커스페이스를 이용하시기 위해서는 GUIDE 페이지의 안내를 따라 주시기 바랍니다.
​
Maker Space를 이용하기 위해서는 학부생 및 대학원생들은 매학기 제공되는 메이커 입문 수업 수강후 Satisfactory 취득후 사용가능하며, 창업기업인 및 일반인들은 Online 수업을 들으신 뒤 Certificate 을 받으시면 해당 기기를 사용가능합니다. 혹시나 학부생이나 대학원생 중 3D Printer  만 사용하실 분들은 3D Printer 기기 사용을 위한 개별 Course 수료후 Certificate  만으로 사용이 가능합니다.
대부분의 기기들은 무료로 제공되나 일부 대형 기기는 유료로 사용 가능하며, 사용되는 재료는 사용자께서 가져오셔야 합니다.
​
단순한 기기 제공 장소가 아닌 학습하며 성장할 수 있는 함께하는 커뮤니티가 되기 위하여 Maker Space 에서의 모든 작업내용은 서로 보고 배울 수 있도록 Maker Community 를 통해 모든 구성원들에게 제공됩니다.  지속적으로 다함께 사용할 수 있는 건강하고 안전한 Maker Space로 유지하기 위해 사용후 기기 및 주변환경을 정리해 주시고 사용하고 남은 재료는 회수하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Integrated Circuits and Systems Lab
is a research group within the Department of Semiconductor Engineering at POSTECH, Korea. Our work focuses on the design of CMOS full-custom circuits, with a particular emphasis on high-bandwidth, low-power interface solutions. These circuits support data communication across various levels—from die-to-die
interconnects
to system-to-system
links
. In addition, we are actively exploring the design of advanced analog and mixed-signal circuits for next-generation applications.

Eunmi's work on spatiotemporal and economic impacts of media on water conservation during the 2022-23 drought is accepted in Water Resources Research. In this study, she proposed an explainable AI approach and found that drought-related news patterns can serve as a proxy to inform potential region and stage-specific water-saving targets, reflecting differences between metropolitan and rural areas. This study underscores the value of explainable AI in providing a quantitative framework to capture human-nature interactions and support the design of targeted drought communication strategies in a timely manner.

Kiru's work on changes in risk communication with forecast error types during Typhoon Khanun is accepted in GeoHealth. In this study, he investigated associations of emotional divergence in risk communication with forecast error types during Typhoon Khanun from over 4,300 online discourses in the NAVER Report Talk platform. He found that the spatial discrepancies of precipitation forecasts are associated with distinct emotional responses of the public: overestimation (underestimation) makes anxiety and worry (stress and confusion) the dominant emotion types in the discourses.

Clean Steel Laboratory,

Eco Materials Technology,
Department of Materials Science and Engineering (JA),
Pohang University of Science and Technology
In the Clean Steel Laboratory (CSL) of the Graduate Institute of Ferrous and Eco Materials Technology and jointly associated with Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Pohang University of Science and Technology, we are aiming to contribute to our academic community and steel industry by carrying out research, education, and communication.  The main research area of interest is chemical metallurgy, including chemical thermodynamics, kinetics, and solidification.  The practical application area includes the pyrometallurgical process, in particular for steelmaking and continuous casting processes.
We are looking for students and post-docs who are interested in high-temperature process metallurgy including molten steel cleanliness (chemical refining and inclusion control), ferrous scrap and Li-ion battery recycling, hydrogen production, hydrogen ironmaking, low C emission steel production via chemical metallurgical principles (thermodynamics, kinetics, physicochemical properties of melts, etc.). If you are interested in carrying out the research at CSL, please contact Dr. Youn-Bae Kang.
If you are interested in this position, please contact Dr. Youn-Bae Kang.

저희는 인공지능과 전산모사를 활용하여 다양한 소재(금속, 이차전지, 반도체)를 설계하고 있습니다.

Methodology
Research 01
Machine Learning
We are trying to find materials with properties of interest through investigations of key parameters learned from the large database.
VIEW MORE

Phase-Field Model
We are performing the state-of-art phase-field modeling (PFM) or mean-field modeling to simulate micro structure dynamics to optimize the micro structures with time and temperature.
VIEW MORE
Research 03
First-principles Density Functional Calculation
We are performing an atomic-scale analysis of the structure and energetics of the various crystal structures of compounds.
VIEW MORE
Research 04
Theoretical Model Development
We are developing theoretical models for materials design.
VIEW MORE

Experiment
We are designing new materials in experiment based on theoretical and computational approaches (ICME).

Project Management & Systems Engineering Lab (PML)
POSTECH PML is a laboratory for reinforcing core management capabilities for the entire project cycle and developing optimal PM technology for successful project management of plant engineering projects such as capital projects in the energy sector. For successful business management of mega-projects including overseas plants, core management capabilities for the entire business cycle, including business feasibility analysis, proposal writing, contract and negotiation, risk management, process management, project cost management, and quality management, and global standard application and optimization We are conducting research to develop PM specialized technology.

RESEARCH 01
Alloy Design
By precisely controlling the alloy composition, heat treatment schedule, and microstructure, it becomes possible to tailor materials to meet specific performance requirements for a wide range of applications.

RESEARCH 02
Fracture Behavior
Through investigating the influential factors on brittle fracture, such as alloy composition, segregation, precipitation, it enhances understanding of the mechanisms underlying steel’s susceptibility to brittle fracture.
MORE VIEW
RESEARCH 03
Microstructure
Characterization
The utilization of advanced characterization techniques, such as TEM, FE-SEM(EPMA, EBSD), APT for multi-scale linking, assists in elucidating unknown mechanisms associated with surface reaction (oxidation, blister) or strengthening processes(dislocation interaction with solute, precipitation).
MORE VIEW
ABOUT LAB
Lab
Media
Alloy Design Lab specializes in analyzing the microstructure of materials to identify the correlations among different characterization factors.
Through the utilization of diverse analytical techniques, including various microscopy methods and theoretical calculations, our primary goal is to comprehend the relationship between
properties that emerge at the microstructural level and those exhibited at the macro level when materials are in their bulk state.

Innovative Energy Materials Laboratory
POSTECH
"From hidden battery dynamics  to materials and electrode design"
We study rechargeable Li/Na batteries across atomic, interfacial, particle, and electrode scales.
By revealing the mechanisms that govern Li/Na transport, charge transfer, reaction heterogeneity, and degradation.
we aim to establish design principles for next-generation energy storage materials.
